dataset.name: synthetic_linear_v1
dataset.label_semantics: Fictional active/inactive outcome; no biological efficacy meaning.
dataset.source: Original in-process synthetic generator; no external data.
dataset.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only to revealed training rows.

manifest.initial_label_selection: Deterministic synthetic-only stratification; disclosed oracle intervention.
manifest.scheduler: At most batch_size concurrent pending assays; settle each result at its due step.
manifest.cost_note: Reserve on request; settle on delivery or missing outcome; no refunds.
manifest.delay_note: Integer simulated steps; deterministic nonnegative per-candidate jitter.
limitations: Personal independent prototype; not an official GPO project or endorsed system.
Data origin and assay semantics are dataset-specific; retrospective labels are not drug efficacy evidence.
Cost, capacity, delay and missingness are SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION; no currency or actual savings.
Seed labels are common preexisting sunk cost and excluded from new hits. Only synthetic seeds are stratified.
Logistic probabilities are uncalibrated; closeness to 0.5 is a heuristic, not validated uncertainty.
Single-seed comparisons illustrate behavior. Multi-seed variability on one assay is not cross-target validation.
Learned controllers train on synthetic tasks only; no validated pharmaceutical transfer, lab integration, Digital Twin or GMP/clinical use.
Built-in policy process separation is not an OS sandbox for hostile code or reconstructed synthetic truth.

events.explanation: Original synthetic fixture; no live laboratory.

metrics.auc_definition: Left-step integral to configured budget; normalized by budget * floor(budget/assay_cost).
